assumptions: Level 60/R6; 600 seconds; stationary target with one billion HP, no target armor, resistance, retaliation or forced movement.

Permanent passives always included. No active buffs in none. Own and own group buffs activated and paid in own. In party, current group buffs at highest provider cap are prepared permanently; remaining own buffs activated and paid.

Nature Spirit included as normal class summon in every Druid strategy, including energy-only. Regular pets excluded. No random critical hits/procs. Forgotten Spell excluded because no target is selected.
Healer evaluated offensively without spending Mana on group healing or resurrection; these are not estimates of healer performance while actively healing.
Only Druid Energy Strike class cap is varied, five versus ten; the existing higher-level damage, Mana and cooldown progression is used. Other classes retain their actual caps.
Finite attack/buff subset and priority search, coarse step 0.05 seconds and finalists 0.01 seconds. Best found is not proof of a globally optimal rotation.
Energy-only comparison includes normal filler autos and class summons; separate energySpam result suppresses autos.

Additional exact-grid cross-check: each Druid level runs the other level’s winning policy. Mixed scheduling and energy-only mixed scheduling are also tested for all four variants; only higher-damage results replace the incumbent.
